Chapter 6603: Calamity

Chapter 6603: Calamity

Deeper into the crack was the formation of a heavenly dao. Images of immortal cauldrons, gigantic bamboos, wonderful beings manifested into reality... Three thousand worlds seemed to be born from its light.

freё.com

“What’s that?” Spectators were shocked to see it.

“Why is this supreme grand dao appearing? Is it naturally formed?” A primal ancestor said.

“World Seal is incredible, it can form a heavenly dao.” An overlord was surprised to see this.

“Awakening without a master and possessing such power, what a monstrous weapon.” Another overlord murmured.

Overlords thought World Seal was weaker than Calamitous Edge. However, it had more uses than just killing.

World Seal could suppress and more magically, replicate anything. This included weapons, worlds, immortal arts, or even cultivators...

Not to mention overlords, even immortals coveted this artifact. Therefore, it was placed second after Calamitous Edge.

“Boom!” The conjured Three Immortals contracted into a single point, harnessing all worldly energy.

The condensed power resembled a dewdrop falling into Heaven World.

“Pop!” It inexplicably sealed a particular set of coordinates.

“What’s happening?” Primal ancestors and heaven-slayers became confused.

“This is bad!” An overlord blurted.

Radiance erupted from the sealed coordinates and rotated like a vortex. In this split second, the heavenly dao with numerous visual phenomena plummeted into the targeted coordinates.

Everyone screamed in horror as it pierced through space.

“Crackle!” Bolts of lightning shot outward, one after another. They formed arcs expanding in all directions, threatening the entire Heaven World with deafening blasts.

“Is this the end?!” Cultivators turned pale with fear due to the potential for destruction.

This was only the beginning. Truly dreadful lightning bolts came afterward, each as thick as a mountain range.

They varied in appearance. Some were golden like the spears of heaven, capable of pinning all evil to the ground with a single strike. Others were blood-red with a curse, always conjuring heavenly tribulations. Then the third type was gray, assaulting the dao heart itself...

This frightened everyone including the few immortals since these bolts carried the power of tribulations. Most had never seen them before since they were at the overlord level and up. Weaker cultivators fell to the ground, paralyzed.

As the tribulation swept through, flashes appeared on their body. They had to deal with their own tribulations. The stronger their cultivation, the stronger the tribulation.

“Calamities!” An overlord knew who it was.

Meanwhile, the heavenly dao assaulted the source of the lightning, revealing a figure.

“Go!” He raised his hand and retaliated with numerous tribulations.

They pierced through the dao and made it into a sieve. However, the endless power of this dao enforced it as it wrapped around him.

He exploded in rage and tribulations erupted from his body. Alas, the endless dao continued to envelop him.

“Damn, you must replicate me?! Even First Vine didn’t go this far. Li Xingchen, you bastard!” He cursed.

“It’s Calamities!” Some recognized his voice.
